1. Test variations of the best config to see if we can improve upon it.
2. Test whether the image encoder matters (resnet50 vs imagenet_vit_l).
3. Test whether the fusion strategy matters (weighted vs concat).

- config_013 (test ViT-L vs ResNet50) - one variable change

Alternatively, config_028 tests the fusion strategy, which is also important but perhaps less likely to yield a large jump than upgrading the image encoder.

3. It keeps the proven scgpt + transformer + weighted + multiprofile combination intact.
